sections.title: Scoring
facts: $25$ problems in $75$ minutes: $6$ for a right answer, $1.5$ for a blank, $0$ for a wrong answer.
Every problem is worth the same: bank the easy points first.
Check your answer sheet in the last few minutes.

sections.title: Pacing & the 2-minute rule
facts: First pass in order; no plan after 2 minutes? Flag it and move on.
Aim to finish the first pass with about $25$ minutes left.
Second pass: the most promising flagged problems first.

sections.title: Guessing vs a blank
facts: A wild guess is worth $\frac{6}{5} = 1.2$ points, less than a blank.
Rule out $1$ choice: $1.5$ (a tie). Rule out $2$: $2$ points, so guess.
Never leave the answer sheet in a muddle: check the letters.
